cards.example: The step-up transformer raises the generator output to 220 kV before it leaves the site.
All the medium-voltage switchgear was replaced during the plant shutdown.
cards.note: Sustantivo incontable: “a switchgear panel”, nunca “a switchgear”.

cards.example: The circuit breaker opened within milliseconds, clearing the fault before the cables overheated.
cards.note: En baja tensión también se oye “MCB” (miniature circuit breaker).

cards.example: A loose bolted joint on the busbar was detected during the thermographic survey.
cards.note: Se escribe junto; “busbar section” = tramo de embarrado.

cards.example: The disconnector may only be operated once the circuit breaker has been opened.
cards.note: El seccionador NO corta carga; por eso la secuencia de maniobra importa.

cards.example: Temporary earthing must be applied before anyone touches the conductors.
cards.note: En inglés británico se dice “earth”; “ground” es americano.

cards.example: A rodent caused a short circuit that took the entire feeder out of service.
cards.note: Verbo: “to short-circuit”. “Short-circuit current” = intensidad de cortocircuito.

cards.example: The overcurrent protection settings had not been reviewed since the new motors were installed.
cards.note: “Overload” = sobrecarga (más lenta); “overcurrent” es el término genérico.

cards.example: A faulty protection relay sent a spurious trip signal to the main breaker.

cards.front: high / medium / low voltage (HV / MV / LV)
cards.back: alta / media / baja tensión (AT / MT / BT)
cards.example: Only authorised persons may enter the high-voltage compound.
cards.note: En inglés técnico “voltage”, no “tension”, salvo en mecánica (tensión de un cable o correa).

cards.example: The workshop needs a three-phase supply to run the new lathe.
Large induction motors draw considerable reactive power from the network.
cards.note: Se mide en kvar; potencia activa (kW) y aparente (kVA).

cards.example: Installing a capacitor bank for power factor correction cut the penalty on our electricity bill.
Variable-speed drives introduce harmonics that can overheat neutral conductors.
cards.note: Casi siempre en plural. “Harmonic distortion (THD)” = distorsión armónica.

cards.example: Technicians must wear arc-flash-rated clothing when racking out breakers.
cards.note: “Arc flash boundary” = distancia de protección frente a arco.

cards.example: The breaker tripped twice in an hour, so we isolated the circuit for investigation.
cards.note: También sustantivo: “a nuisance trip” = disparo intempestivo.

cards.back: poner en tensión / dejar sin tensión
cards.example: The line will not be re-energised until the crew has confirmed it is clear.
Never assume a cable is dead: test it as if it were live.
cards.note: Pronunciación /laɪv/. Opuesto: “dead”. “Live working” = trabajos en tensión.

cards.example: The motor failed the insulation resistance test after the flood.
cards.note: Coloquialmente “megger test”, por la marca del instrumento.

cards.example: Power and control cables should run in separate cable trays to avoid interference.
Each production line is fed from its own distribution board.
cards.note: En el hogar británico: “consumer unit” (cuadro general).

cards.example: The control room servers are backed by a UPS rated for twenty minutes.
cards.note: Falso amigo de siglas: SAI en español, UPS en inglés.

cards.example: The standby generator kicked in seconds after the mains supply failed.
cards.note: “Mains” = red (suministro de la compañía); “genset” es coloquial.

cards.example: The long cable run caused an unacceptable voltage drop at the pump motor.
cards.note: Se calcula al dimensionar cables; no confundir con “voltage dip” (hueco de tensión).

cards.example: Storm damage to the overhead line left three villages without power.
cards.note: Opuesto: “underground cable”. “Pylon” = torre de alta tensión.

cards.example: Update the single-line diagram before you hand over the modified installation.
The current transformer feeds the metering and protection circuits.
cards.note: Ojo: “current” = intensidad/corriente. El de tensión es “voltage transformer (VT)”.

cards.example: The RCD tripped as soon as the damaged extension lead was plugged in.
cards.note: En EE. UU. se dice “GFCI”. Protege a las personas, no a los cables.

cards.example: The new connection raised the fault level beyond the rating of the existing switchgear.
cards.note: Se expresa en MVA o kA; clave al seleccionar aparamenta.

cards.example: Automatic load shedding disconnected non-essential consumers to keep the island network stable.
cards.note: También se usa para los cortes programados en países con déficit de generación.

cards.example: A worn bearing was the source of the high-pitched noise in the fan.
cards.note: “Ball bearing” = rodamiento de bolas; “plain bearing” = cojinete de fricción.

cards.example: The pump shaft had snapped just behind the impeller.
cards.note: “Axle” es el eje de un vehículo; “shaft” el de una máquina rotativa.

cards.example: Oil analysis revealed metal particles in the gearbox.
A flexible coupling absorbs small misalignments between the motor and the pump.
Shaft misalignment is one of the commonest causes of premature bearing failure.
Over-lubricating a bearing can be just as harmful as neglecting it.
Vibration analysis flagged an imbalance weeks before the fan would have failed.

cards.back: monitorización del estado (mantenimiento basado en la condición)
cards.example: Condition monitoring allows us to intervene only when the data justify it.
cards.note: Abarca vibraciones, termografía, análisis de aceite, ultrasonidos...

cards.example: Predictive maintenance has cut unplanned stoppages by almost a third.
cards.note: Frente a “preventive” (por calendario) y “corrective” (tras el fallo).

cards.example: Too much of the budget still goes on breakdown maintenance.
cards.note: “Reactive maintenance” es sinónimo, con matiz negativo.

cards.example: Upgrading the seals doubled the MTBF of the slurry pumps.
cards.note: Indicador de fiabilidad; se pronuncia letra a letra.

cards.example: Keeping critical spares on site has reduced our MTTR considerably.
cards.note: Indicador de mantenibilidad; complementa al MTBF.

cards.example: We hold critical spares for any item with a long lead time.
cards.note: “Spares” a secas es habitual en el taller.

cards.example: The mechanical seal was leaking, so the pump was taken out of service.
cards.note: “Gasket” es junta estática (bridas); “seal” suele ser dinámica (ejes).

cards.example: Investigators traced the crack to metal fatigue at a weld toe.
cards.note: “Fatigue crack” = grieta por fatiga; “fatigue life” = vida a fatiga.

cards.example: Without oil, the compressor seized up within minutes.
Flange bolts must be tightened to the torque specified by the manufacturer.
Cavitation had pitted the impeller because the suction pressure was too low.
cards.note: Suele asociarse a un NPSH disponible insuficiente.

cards.example: A thermal imaging survey revealed an overheating coupling.
No job should start without an approved work order.
cards.note: Abreviado “WO”. “To raise a work order” = emitir una OT.

cards.back: sistema de gestión del mantenimiento asistido por ordenador (GMAO)
cards.example: Every intervention must be logged in the CMMS to build a reliable history.
The turbine is due for a major overhaul next spring.
cards.note: También verbo: “to overhaul a gearbox”. Sentido figurado: reformar a fondo.

cards.example: The fitters stripped down the valve to inspect the seat.
Chloride-induced corrosion had weakened the supports near the cooling tower.
cards.note: Verbo “to corrode”; adjetivo “corrosive”. “Rust” = óxido (solo en hierro/acero).

cards.example: Excessive backlash in the gear train caused positioning errors.
cards.note: En sentido general “backlash” = reacción negativa (p. ej. del público).

cards.back: mecánico ajustador / técnico de mantenimiento mecánico
cards.example: Two fitters and an electrician were assigned to the shutdown.
cards.note: No es “montador de muebles”; es oficio industrial.

cards.example: The air compressor runs continuously because of leaks in the network.
cards.note: “Compressed air leaks” = fugas de aire comprimido, gran fuente de derroche.

cards.example: A damaged rod seal let oil escape from the hydraulic cylinder.
cards.note: “Hydraulic fluid” = aceite hidráulico; “ram” es sinónimo coloquial.

cards.example: An RCM study helped us decide which assets deserve predictive techniques.
For cheap, non-critical lamps a run-to-failure strategy is perfectly acceptable.
cards.note: Estrategia deliberada, no negligencia: se usa como adjetivo compuesto.

cards.example: The HAZOP team spent two days reviewing the new reactor feed system.
cards.note: Se dice “to carry out / hold a HAZOP”. Se pronuncia /ˈhæzɒp/.

cards.example: Applying the guide word “reverse” revealed that backflow was possible.
cards.note: Ejemplos: no, more, less, reverse, other than, as well as.

cards.example: Each deviation is analysed for its causes, consequences and existing safeguards.
cards.note: Deviation = guide word + parámetro (p. ej. “more pressure”).

cards.example: We divided the distillation unit into eight nodes.
cards.note: Sección del proceso analizada de forma independiente.

cards.example: The site falls under the Seveso Directive because of the quantity of chlorine stored.
cards.note: En España se transpone mediante el reglamento de accidentes graves.

cards.example: Operators must demonstrate that all major-accident hazards have been identified.
cards.note: Expresión clave en la normativa Seveso.

cards.example: As an upper-tier establishment, the refinery must submit a full safety report.
cards.note: Depende de las cantidades umbral de sustancias peligrosas.

cards.example: The safety report must be reviewed at least every five years.
cards.note: Documento formal exigido a establecimientos de nivel superior.

cards.example: The external emergency plan is drawn up by the civil protection authorities.
cards.note: El interior lo elabora la empresa; el exterior, la administración.

cards.example: LOPA showed that an additional independent safeguard was required.
cards.note: Método semicuantitativo que suele seguir al HAZOP.

cards.example: The SIS will close the feed valve if the temperature exceeds the trip setting.
cards.note: Independiente del sistema de control básico (BPCS).

cards.example: The high-pressure trip was assigned SIL 2.
Operators initiated an emergency shutdown when the gas alarm sounded.
cards.note: También “ESD valve” = válvula de corte de emergencia.

cards.example: Loss of cooling can trigger a runaway reaction in an exothermic batch.
Solvents with a low flash point must be stored away from ignition sources.
cards.note: No confundir con “autoignition temperature” (temperatura de autoignición).

cards.example: The gas detector alarms at 10% of the LEL.
Most major accidents begin with a loss of containment.
cards.note: Término genérico para fugas, derrames o roturas.

cards.back: BLEVE (explosión de vapor en expansión de líquido en ebullición)
cards.example: Firefighters kept the LPG tank cool to prevent a BLEVE.
cards.note: Se pronuncia /ˈblevi/. Típico de depósitos de GLP expuestos al fuego.

cards.example: The bund must hold at least 110% of the largest tank’s capacity.
Excess gas was sent to the flare during the start-up.
cards.note: “Flaring” = quema en antorcha; en sentido general “to flare up” = recrudecerse.

cards.example: Nitrogen blanketing keeps oxygen out of the solvent tank.
Replacing the valve with a different model should have gone through management of change.
cards.note: Muchos accidentes se deben a cambios “menores” no evaluados.

cards.back: seguridad de procesos vs seguridad laboral
cards.example: A low injury rate says little about process safety.
cards.note: Lección clásica: buenos índices de accidentes laborales no garantizan ausencia de riesgo de accidente grave.

cards.example: The bow-tie analysis set out the barriers on both sides of the top event.
cards.note: Izquierda: amenazas y barreras preventivas; derecha: consecuencias y mitigación.

cards.example: Tank spacing was increased to reduce the risk of a domino effect.
cards.note: Concepto también recogido en la normativa Seveso.

cards.back: límites seguros de operación / ventana operativa
cards.example: The unit was operated outside its safe operating limits for several hours.
cards.note: “To stay within the envelope” = mantenerse dentro de la ventana.

cards.example: Oxidisers and flammable liquids are incompatible substances and must be segregated.
Congestion in the pipe rack made a vapour cloud explosion more severe.
The vents are designed for a deflagration, not a detonation.
During the upset, an alarm flood overwhelmed the panel operator.
Blue hydrogen relies on carbon capture to cut the emissions of grey hydrogen.
cards.note: Gris: de gas natural sin captura; azul: con captura de CO₂.

cards.example: PEM electrolysers respond quickly to fluctuations in renewable output.
Alkaline electrolysis is a mature, lower-cost technology.
cards.note: Tecnología veterana frente a PEM y SOEC.

cards.example: The forklifts are powered by hydrogen fuel cells.
Hydrogen embrittlement limits which steels can be used in pipelines.
cards.note: Clave al reutilizar gasoductos de gas natural.

cards.example: The tube trailers carry compressed hydrogen at 300 bar.
Liquefaction consumes roughly a third of the energy content of the hydrogen.
Ammonia is being studied as a hydrogen carrier for long-distance shipping.
The region aims to become a hydrogen valley linking producers and industrial users.
cards.note: Concentración geográfica de producción y consumo.

cards.back: mezcla / inyección en la red de gas
cards.example: Blending up to 5% hydrogen requires few changes to domestic appliances.
A new refuelling station will serve the city’s hydrogen buses.
Lithium-ion batteries dominate the stationary storage market.
Hundreds of cells are grouped into modules, which form the battery pack.
The system keeps the state of charge between 10% and 90% to extend battery life.
cards.note: Diferente de “state of health (SoH)” = estado de salud.

cards.example: Deep discharges shorten battery life, so the depth of discharge is limited.
cards.note: Relacionado inversamente con la vida en ciclos.

cards.example: The battery offers a round-trip efficiency of around 88%.
cards.note: Compara energía recuperada con energía almacenada.

cards.example: A single damaged cell can trigger thermal runaway across the whole rack.
cards.note: Riesgo principal de incendio en baterías de litio.

cards.example: The BMS isolated the module as soon as it detected abnormal temperatures.
cards.note: Controla tensión, temperatura y equilibrado de celdas.

cards.example: Manufacturers guarantee a cycle life of 6,000 cycles.
cards.note: Frente a “calendar life” (vida por envejecimiento temporal).

cards.example: Capacity fade must be factored into the financial model.
Pumped hydro storage still provides most of the world’s storage capacity.
Vanadium flow batteries suit long-duration applications.
cards.note: Potencia y energía se dimensionan por separado.

cards.back: detrás del contador (en instalaciones del cliente)
cards.example: Behind-the-meter storage lets the factory reduce its peak charges.
Peak shaving with batteries lowered the contracted power.
cards.note: No confundir con “load shifting” (desplazamiento de cargas).

cards.back: a escala de red / de gran escala
cards.example: A utility-scale battery was commissioned next to the wind farm.
cards.note: Se usa como adjetivo compuesto delante del sustantivo.

cards.example: Second-life batteries from electric buses now provide backup at the depot.
cards.note: Baterías de VE reutilizadas en aplicaciones estacionarias.

cards.example: Lithium, cobalt and graphite are classed as critical raw materials in the EU.
cards.note: Concepto de la política industrial europea.

cards.example: The gigafactory will produce cells for 300,000 vehicles a year.
cards.note: Gran planta de fabricación de baterías.

cards.back: power-to-X (conversión de electricidad en otros vectores)
cards.example: Power-to-X projects turn surplus electricity into hydrogen, methanol or ammonia.
cards.note: Se mantiene en inglés en textos técnicos españoles.

cards.example: The battery earns revenue through energy arbitrage, charging when prices are low.

cards.back: trabajos de cimentación y movimiento de tierras
cards.example: Groundworks were delayed by three weeks of heavy rain.
cards.note: Fase inicial de la obra; suele ir en plural.

cards.example: The excavation for the tank foundations reached the water table.
The press requires isolated footings to absorb vibration.
cards.note: “To lay the foundations” también en sentido figurado.

cards.example: Poor ground conditions meant the warehouse had to be built on piling.
The silo is a reinforced concrete structure.
cards.note: “Concrete” = hormigón (falso amigo con “concreto”). “Cement” es solo el conglomerante.

cards.example: The inspector checked the rebar spacing before the pour.
The formwork can be struck once the concrete has gained sufficient strength.
The slab was poured overnight to avoid the afternoon heat.
Inadequate curing led to surface cracks.
cards.note: Verbo “to cure”; no confundir con “to heal”.

cards.example: Precast panels sped up the construction of the plant building.
The steelwork erection is scheduled for September.
The scaffolding must be inspected weekly and after bad weather.
High winds forced the tower crane to stop work.
cards.note: “Mobile crane” = grúa móvil; “lifting plan” = plan de izado.

cards.example: The foreman briefed the crew on the day’s lifting operations.
The electrical installation was let to a specialist subcontractor.
Tenderers price each item in the bill of quantities.
cards.note: Documento clave en licitaciones de obra británicas.

cards.example: The contractor has not yet delivered the as-built drawings.
cards.note: Reflejan lo realmente construido, no lo proyectado.

cards.example: Twenty items remain on the snagging list.
You cannot remove a load-bearing wall without a structural assessment.
The geotechnical survey revealed soft clay beneath the site.
cards.note: “Site investigation” es un término equivalente más amplio.

cards.example: A retaining wall was built to stabilise the embankment.
Balancing cut and fill reduced the amount of material taken off site.
Compaction tests must be passed before the slab is laid.
The extension cannot start until planning permission is granted.

cards.back: plan de seguridad y salud (de obra)
cards.example: The construction phase plan sets out how site risks will be managed.
cards.note: Equivalente británico aproximado del plan de SyS español.

cards.example: The trench was backfilled once the pipe had been tested.
Practical completion was certified on 30 June.
cards.note: Marca el inicio del periodo de garantía.

cards.example: Any cracks appearing during the defects liability period must be repaired by the contractor.
cards.note: Suele ser de 12 meses en contratos británicos.

cards.example: Unsupported trenches deeper than 1.2 m are a serious collapse hazard.
Setting out errors placed the column bases 20 cm off the grid.

cards.back: ley del mineral / ley de corte
cards.example: Falling copper prices raised the cut-off grade and shrank the mineable reserve.
cards.note: Ojo: “ley” NO es “law” en este contexto.

cards.example: A high stripping ratio makes the deeper pit uneconomic.
cards.note: Cantidad de estéril movida por unidad de mineral.

cards.example: The drill-and-blast cycle determines the daily advance in the tunnel.
cards.note: Se usa como adjetivo compuesto: “drill-and-blast method”.

cards.example: The engineer reduced the burden to improve fragmentation.
Insufficient stemming allowed gases to vent and caused fly rock.
cards.note: Material inerte que confina la carga en el barreno.

cards.example: Electronic detonators allow precise delays between holes.
Fly rock is one of the most serious hazards associated with surface blasting.
cards.note: También “flyrock”. El área de exclusión se define por este riesgo.

cards.example: Neighbours complained about the airblast rather than the ground vibration.
cards.note: Se mide en dB(L) o Pa.

cards.example: The old headframe has been preserved as a landmark.
cards.note: “To sink a shaft” = profundizar un pozo.

cards.example: Access to the deposit is through an adit driven into the hillside.
cards.note: “Adit” es horizontal desde superficie; “drift”, galería que sigue la capa.

cards.back: cámara de explotación / explotación por cámaras
cards.example: Each stope is backfilled with cemented tailings once it is mined out.
Room-and-pillar mining leaves part of the ore in place as support.
cards.note: Método típico en potasa y carbón.

cards.example: Longwall mining achieves high recovery but causes surface subsidence.
A second ventilation shaft was sunk to dilute diesel exhaust.
Continuous firedamp monitoring is mandatory in gassy coal mines.
cards.note: Término histórico para el metano en minas; “gassy mine” = mina grisuosa.

cards.example: Comminution accounts for most of the plant’s energy consumption.
cards.note: Término técnico que engloba crushing + grinding.

cards.example: The ball mill grinds the ore to below 100 microns.
Screening separates fines from oversize before the secondary crusher.
The zinc concentrate is trucked to the port for export.
cards.note: Sustantivo contable aquí, no el verbo “concentrate”.

cards.example: Fine grinding raised gold recovery from 82% to 89%.
cards.note: Porcentaje del metal contenido que se recupera.

cards.example: Water recovered from the thickener is recycled to the mill.
cards.note: Equipo de separación sólido-líquido por sedimentación.

cards.example: Low-grade oxide ore is treated by heap leaching.
The concentrate is sold to a smelter overseas.
Assay results confirmed the high-grade intercept.
The expansion extends the life of mine to 2045.
cards.note: “LOM plan” = plan minero a largo plazo.

cards.example: A dragline removes the overburden above the coal seam.
cards.note: Excavadora de cables con cazo de arrastre.

cards.example: Two wheel loaders feed the primary crusher.
Water bowsers are used for dust suppression on dry days.
Old workings caused subsidence beneath the village road.
The site water balance shows a deficit during the summer months.
cards.note: Herramienta clave para gestionar balsas y vertidos.

cards.example: Public procurement rules require transparency and equal treatment of bidders.

cards.front: invitation to tender (ITT) / call for tenders
cards.example: The invitation to tender was published in the EU journal.
Bidders must submit a bid bond equal to 2% of their offer.
cards.note: Garantiza que el licitador mantendrá su oferta.

cards.example: The contractor provided a performance bond worth 5% of the contract value.
cards.note: Se ejecuta si el contratista incumple.

cards.example: The technical specifications must not favour a particular brand.
Price accounted for only 40% of the award criteria.
The contract will go to the most economically advantageous tender, not simply the cheapest.
The authority asked the bidder to justify its abnormally low tender.
The contracting authority may reject incomplete bids.
Spare parts are purchased under a four-year framework agreement.
cards.note: “Call-off” = contrato basado en el acuerdo marco.

cards.example: Under the restricted procedure only pre-qualified firms may bid.
cards.note: En el abierto cualquier operador puede presentar oferta.

cards.example: A negotiated procedure was justified by extreme urgency.
The contract was divided into lots to encourage SMEs to bid.
Five tenderers submitted compliant bids.
No contract may be signed during the ten-day standstill period.
cards.note: Permite a los licitadores recurrir la adjudicación.

cards.example: All bids must be submitted electronically.
cards.note: Colocación: “submit / put in / lodge a bid”.

cards.example: Late bids received after the closing date will be disregarded.
cards.note: “To extend the deadline” = ampliar el plazo.

cards.back: contrato a tanto alzado / precio cerrado
cards.example: Under a lump-sum contract the contractor bears the risk of cost overruns.
Cost-plus contracts offer little incentive to control spending.
cards.note: El cliente paga costes reales más un margen o fee.

cards.example: Liquidated damages of 0.1% per day will be applied for late delivery.
cards.note: Falso amigo: nada que ver con “liquidar”; son daños preestablecidos.

cards.example: The supplier invoked force majeure after the port was closed.
cards.note: Expresión francesa usada en inglés jurídico.

cards.example: Five per cent retention is held until the defects period expires.
cards.note: Parte de cada certificación retenida como garantía.

cards.example: No invoice can be paid without a matching purchase order.
We sent an RFQ to three suppliers for the valves.
cards.note: Para importes menores que una licitación formal.

cards.back: homologación de proveedores / lista de proveedores homologados
cards.example: Only firms on the approved vendor list may quote.
Evaluators must declare any conflict of interest before scoring.
cards.note: En español en plural “intereses”; en inglés singular.

cards.example: The competition authority fined four firms for bid rigging.
The authority terminated the contract for repeated breaches.
Delivery is DAP under Incoterms 2020.
cards.note: Definen reparto de costes y riesgos en el transporte.

cards.example: Single-source procurement must be justified in writing.
The defendant sat impassively as the charges were read out.
cards.note: En lo penal = acusado; en lo civil = demandado.

cards.example: The claimant is seeking compensation for the injuries she sustained.
cards.note: “Plaintiff” es el término tradicional y americano.

cards.back: abogado defensor / abogado (que litiga en sala)
cards.example: Defence counsel argued that the search had been unlawful.
cards.note: “Solicitor” = abogado que asesora y prepara; “barrister” = el que litiga.

cards.example: He pleaded not guilty to all three counts.
The jury returned a unanimous verdict after six hours.
She was acquitted on the grounds of insufficient evidence.
The court convicted him of aggravated burglary.
The judge sentenced her to four years’ imprisonment.
Given his clean record, he received a suspended sentence.
cards.note: No ingresa en prisión salvo que reincida.

cards.example: The officer testified that the van had no lights on.
cards.note: “To give evidence” es más habitual en el Reino Unido.

cards.example: Under cross-examination, the witness admitted she had not seen the driver’s face.
cards.note: “Examination-in-chief” = interrogatorio de la parte que propone al testigo.

cards.example: Lying under oath constitutes perjury.
The judge excluded the statement as hearsay.
cards.note: Por regla general inadmisible, con excepciones.

cards.example: In criminal cases the burden of proof lies with the prosecution.
cards.note: “The onus is on…” es una alternativa formal.

cards.back: más allá de toda duda razonable
cards.example: The prosecution must prove guilt beyond reasonable doubt.
cards.note: Estándar penal; en civil “on the balance of probabilities”.

cards.example: Media coverage must not undermine the presumption of innocence.
cards.note: Derecho fundamental; no es “presumption of innocent”.

cards.example: The hearing was adjourned until an interpreter could be found.
The defence intends to appeal against the sentence.
cards.note: En inglés británico “appeal against”; en americano “appeal” sin preposición.

cards.example: The court ruled that it lacked jurisdiction over offences committed at sea.
Publishing the juror’s name could amount to contempt of court.
The witness received a summons to appear on 12 May.
In Spain, the investigating judge directs the pre-trial phase.
cards.note: No existe en el sistema inglés; útil para explicar el modelo español.

cards.example: The indictment lists twelve separate offences.
The plea bargain reduced the charge to manslaughter.
cards.note: En España: “conformidad” del acusado con la pena.

cards.example: His genuine remorse was accepted as a mitigating circumstance.
The offence fell outside the statute of limitations.
An expert witness explained the ballistic evidence to the jury.
The officer swore an affidavit in support of the application.
The conviction was quashed as a miscarriage of justice.
cards.note: “To quash a conviction” = anular una condena.

cards.example: The minor’s evidence was heard in camera.
cards.note: Nada que ver con cámaras: es latín (“en la cámara”).

cards.example: His firearms certificate was revoked after the domestic incident.
Shell casings of two different calibres were recovered.
Most seized handguns had been illegally converted.
Officers found 200 rounds of ammunition in the boot.
The cartridge cases were bagged and sent for ballistic comparison.
The suspect discarded an empty magazine as he fled.
cards.note: Falso amigo: no es “almacén”; también revista.

cards.example: Every discharge of a firearm by an officer triggers an independent review.
An unintentional discharge occurred while the weapon was being cleaned.
Ballistics linked the weapon to two earlier shootings.
cards.note: Sustantivo incontable con verbo en singular.

cards.example: Swabs were taken from the suspect’s hands to test for gunshot residue.

cards.example: Detonating cord was found among the items in the garage.

cards.back: distancia de seguridad / radio de acordonamiento

cards.example: The technician applied a render-safe procedure to the device.
EOD teams cleared the unexploded shells found on the beach.

cards.example: Casualties underwent decontamination before being taken to hospital.
Only personnel in full protective equipment may enter the hot zone.

cards.back: violencia doméstica / malos tratos en el ámbito familiar

cards.example: Intimate partner violence affects people of all backgrounds.

cards.back: orden de protección / orden de alejamiento
cards.example: He was arrested for approaching her in breach of the restraining order.

cards.example: Online stalking frequently escalates to physical approaches.

cards.back: servicios de atención a la víctima

cards.example: Together they drew up a safety plan, including a code word for emergencies.

cards.back: victimización reiterada / reincidencia sobre la víctima

cards.example: Victims often disclose abuse to a friend before reporting it.

cards.back: línea de ayuda / teléfono de atención

Forced marriage is a criminal offence and a human rights violation.

NPS are designed to evade existing drug controls.
